title: LeMiCa: Lexicographic Minimax Path Caching for Efficient Diffusion-Based Video Generation

layout.note: Two bands stacked on white and separated by a dashed rule. Top band: a colour legend at the top left, under it a DAG of timestep circles with orange skip arrows, and at the right a timestep axis over three rows of coloured cache cells (Original, Traditional, LeMiCa) with their budgets B; a black arrow links the DAG to the LeMiCa row. Bottom band: a tight 3 x 3 grid of video frames, rows named Original, Traditional (TeaCache) and LeMiCa by rotated labels, columns bench, cat and house, with speed-up labels at the top right of the house column.

lesson: Pair a one-glance mechanism band with an output grid: the top band shows each method's schedule as a row of coloured cells with its budget, the bottom grid shows what each schedule produced on the same prompts, under the same row names, so the eye goes from cause to effect.
